prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1360; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Nothing independent confirms the accident: no witnesses, no photos and no other report.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officer narrative: On arrival in League City, Texas, I found two vehicles in the roadway at an intersection. Driver 1 reported that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side while Driver 2 was completing a left turn across their lane. Driver 1 said they felt immediate pain in the lower back and were later checked by emergency medical personnel. Driver 1 and a Passenger were both present in the vehicle when I arrived, and both confirmed their positions at the time of impact. No bystanders were identified, and no photographs or prior reports of this collision were available to me at the scene. Damage to both vehicles was consistent with the impact described by the drivers, with no obvious signs of earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle. The vehicle registration and insurance documents presented listed Driver 1 as the named insured. Driver 2 was cited for failure to yield the right of way. Both vehicles were towed from the scene.
